basic_details.job_title: Amrita Post Doctoral Fellow Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: Amrita Vishwa Vidyapeetham, Amritapuri Campus, invites applications from qualified candidates for the position of Post Doctoral Fellow in the Department of Chemistry, School of Physical Sciences, for a one year contract under the research group of Dr. Beena S. Eligible candidates can submit their applications online until 30 November 2026.

how_to_apply: Visit the official Amrita Vishwa Vidyapeetham careers page or access the application portal via the apply button.
Review the job description and eligibility requirements for the Post Doctoral Fellow position in the Department of Chemistry.
Submit the application on or before November 30, 2026.

content_sections.heading: About Amrita Post Doctoral Fellow
content_sections.text: Amrita Vishwa Vidyapeetham, Amritapuri Campus, operates under the School of Physical Sciences. The research group of Dr. Beena S. invites applications for a Postdoctoral Research Associate for a one year contract. The role supports portable electrochemical device development and nanohybrid materials research for energy storage and point-of-care diagnosis.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates must possess a PhD in Chemistry to be eligible for the Post Doctoral Fellow position. FREEJOBALERT DAILY QUIZ Preparing for Govt Exams? Test Yourself! 25 Questions · 20 Minutes · Instant Score Take Today's Free Quiz →

content_sections.heading: Amrita Post Doctoral Fellow Job Description
content_sections.text: The selected Postdoctoral Research Associate will be responsible for the following duties and tasks: Develop portable electrochemical devices for point-of-care diagnosis, with additional focus on the synthesis and characterization of nanohybrid materials for electrochemical sensing and energy storage applications Designing and synthesizing nanohybrid electrode modifiers Performing advanced materials characterization Analyzing experimental data Preparing research manuscripts Contributing to grant proposals Supporting laboratory management, including supervision and training of students Maintenance of research equipment Participate in collaborative research through international visits to universities and industries

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Amrita Post Doctoral Fellow
content_sections.text: Visit the official Amrita Vishwa Vidyapeetham careers page or access the application portal via the apply button. Review the job description and eligibility requirements for the Post Doctoral Fellow position in the Department of Chemistry. Submit the application on or before November 30, 2026.
